name: Tyler Lamprush
original_name: タイラー・ランプラッシュ
source:
Prince [url=/c156175]Ciaran[/url]'s aide and the brains of the Second Division. He commands the Dragon's Nest, which is their supply depot.

I hear he handles all of Prince Ciaran's day-to-day tasks.
